reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️☆☆☆ Honest Review of Dank Hotel (Stayed 6 nights via Airbnb)
The biggest issue is the misleading location. The Airbnb listing shows the hotel as ~500m from Patong Beach, but the real distance is 1.5 km. Search “86 DANK hotel (420 friendly hotel)” on Google Maps for the accurate spot. The area is very quiet and mostly dead, located opposite a school, and about 2 km from Bangla Road, so the walk to both the beach and nightlife is long.

The only convenient things nearby were Phuket’s Finest, Harman Dispensary, and a 7-Eleven across the road. The manager JB13000 was nice, though the staff struggle with English. The dispensary downstairs had a decent collection but many good strains were out of stock.

Important warning: Some locals hang around the lounge, act friendly, invite you out, and later demand money. They tried to scam me for 4000 THB; I only paid the original amount for 2 people after arguing.
Be cautious and avoid engaging too much.

Overall, not a terrible stay, but the wrong location, quiet surroundings, and scam attempt made the experience disappointing.
